card.name: Digits inside clock times and dates
card.fires_on: A digit in the minutes of a clock time, often after a colon in a time range, or in the day or month part of a URL date. It also fires weakly on season words in 'early fall to early winter'.

modes.label: Minutes in times
modes.description: The digit right after the colon in an event time or time range.

modes.label: Digits in URL dates
modes.description: A digit in the month or day of a date path in a web address.

modes.label: Season words
modes.description: A season word in a range of seasons.
modes.example: Seed Collection: from early<< fall>> to early winter.

card.plain: It marks a digit within a time of day or a date, such as the minutes in 5:30-7:00 pm.
